# Test fixtures

Every file here is synthetic. None of it describes a real member or employer.

- File IDs start with `SYNTH-`.
- NI numbers start with `QQ`, a prefix that is never issued.
- Employer IDs are in the test range `E9xxxx`.
- Names are invented.
- Dates are DD/MM/YYYY, as in every employer feed.

`FixturesAreSyntheticTests` in the unit tests checks the first three rules. Never copy real member or
employer records into this folder, even with the names changed.
